data.description: %1' Cone of Negative Energy %2d%3 negative energy, DC %4, usable every 1d4 rounds. Breath weapons allow a Reflex save for half damage. You are immune to your own breath weapon.  Although it deals negative energy damage, this breath weapon does not heal undead creatures.
